primaryPerson.name: Bánhalmi Norbert
primaryPerson.canonicalDefinition: Norbert Bánhalmi is a Vienna- and Budapest-based executive portrait and fine-art photographer and visual-branding strategist. His professional practice and artistic oeuvre have different functions but belong to the same creator and the same lifelong photographic inquiry into presence.

principalServices: Brand Photography and strategic visual positioning
